description: 06:30 - 09:45: Engaged fish on spear. Evaluated situation. Discussed way forward. Reviewed BHA/WELL schematic and concluded that it was not grapple that hung off, but taper mill hung off. Meanwhile cleared rig floor, serviced drilling equipment, removed scaffold from forward RPS
